name: native-commands.json
lua_assertions:
local order = {}
frozen:addcommand('Begin', function(self, params)
    assert(self == frozen and params == nil)
    order[#order+1] = 'Begin'
    self:SetFOV(45)
    native_target:visible(false)
    native_proxy:SetTarget(native_target)
end)
native_proxy:addcommand('On', function(self)
    order[#order+1] = 'On'
    assert(self:GetTarget() == native_target)
end)
frozen:playcommand('Begin')
native_proxy:playcommand('On')
assert(order[1] == 'Begin' and order[2] == 'On')
local wrapper = native_proxy:AddWrapperState()
assert(wrapper == native_proxy:GetWrapperState(1))
native_proxy:AddWrapperState()
assert(native_proxy:GetNumWrapperStates() == 2)
